reviews.title: What a nice keyboard!
reviews.comment: I really enjoy this keyboard. You can feel the high quality, the mechanical clicking sound is soft and pleasant. The buttons are very responsive and feel just right. RGB is not distracting and very customizable. The wrist pad is a bit harder than other brands, but it feels comfortable and just the right size. I'm really pleased with this keyboard. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Vadim Olari

reviews.title: Quality keyboard. Responsive keys. Comfortable size and layout.
reviews.comment: Purchased this a few weeks ago to replace my aging mechanical keyboard. Keys are responsive and feel great and the layout is good as well. Fitted the keys with a single o-ring and was able to achieve substantially quieter key noise to an already pleasingly quieter keyboard compared to what I was using before. Switches feel great and its nice to know I can simply swap them in the future if I need or want to. Build feels strong and quality. No flex from the frame at all. The only thing I wish for is better lighting control without needing to install the Asus software, but what it does offer from the keyboard itself is fine.
reviews.author: Alex 'Kei' F

reviews.title: Best Asus Keyboard For The Price
reviews.comment: I didn’t get a perfect keyboard. Space bar and left shift key was a bit sticky. I think the kit came with spare keys. It doesn’t bother me enough to need to replace the keys. Regardless with those issues, I definitely recommend this keyboard. I started with an Asus 65% brown keys, next was a Asus 65% blue keys for my Mac, then this snow red keys. It’s way quieter than the brown keys for sure. I got this keyboard for work just to make my dull computer tasks / paperwork more enjoyable. Was it worth the price? I’d say so. I like the weight, it makes it feel like a quality keyboard. Key controls make it easy to change the themes and I appreciate you can change the brightness settings. I did not expect scroll wheel to be useful, and I use it a lot when playing music to skip, pause, and mute songs. My favorite keyboard so far.
reviews.author: Mark Garcia

reviews.title: Very "clicky" keyboard - great feel.
reviews.comment: An amazing keyboard.  If you want the old school "clicky" key feel, this is for you.  I would say it's a medium to large sized keyboard, so if you have big hands it will work out well.  The keys light up very bright.  It's VERY heavy, so it sits well on your desk.  I haven't used the replaceable keys yet - but I was able to pull them off easily (for testing purposes).
reviews.author: genobpgh

reviews.title: Very nice quality, way above my expectations
reviews.comment: I’m very happy with this so far it’s comfortable to use and the key presses are quiet and smooth presses all the way through without any unexpected resistance at the end. The disconnect of the wire at the keyboard itself is very useful for transport to move it off my desk when I need a workspace when I’m not gaming and still leave the wire to easily plug it in again instead of having to dive under my desk to plug in so a big plus there. Then the LEDS are very nice with a lot of colors with adjustable brightness and modes that don’t need a PC to change through the modes which is very good since I’m on Xbox
reviews.author: Caleb Howland
